title: willughbeia sarawacensis
intro: Willughbeia sarawacensis, commonly known as the Sarawak willughbeia or Sarawak willughbya, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Malaysian and Bornean cultures, due to its purported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Willughbeia sarawacensis are attributed to its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Willughbeia sarawacensis include alkaloids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
